method: Sampled opaque text areas at the production start, composing the two scaled plates and authored overlays. Contact uses solid surfaces; bridge end uses solid ink. The block-width H1 container is excluded because its empty area is not text; the inline surname is measured and the first line is visually inspected. Transitional fades are visually inspected rather than treated as steady text.
